svg.desc: The last screen runs ssh suriya@contact and lists four channels: F1 LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/suriyaprakashp, F2 Stack Overflow stackoverflow.com/users/10440572, F3 Docker Hub hub.docker.com/u/suriya4code, F4 Email suriya4code@gmail.com.
